text:
tess_l: Heads up  we need a short ops checklist for post-launch redirects + canonicalization + GTM event wiring for leads from the launch posts/webinar. Keep this tight.
noah_c: I can do the redirect rules and smoke test. Aim: ensure no redirect chains and preserve query params for UTMs.
sam_r: I'll draft meta descriptions and push light schema (Event + FAQ). Also want a canonical canonicalization plan for syndicated content.
pat_k: For inbound lead routing: map utm_source values to SFDC lead_source field. Also create a rule for registration bouncebacks.
seo-bot: Tip: use staging canonical tags to the final canonical to prevent duplicate indexation during preview.
noah_c: Redirect snippet I'll use in CSV:
```
/legacy/posts/llm-econ,/resources/launch/llm-econ,301
/legacy/benchmarks-2021,/resources/launch/benchmarks,301
/register-now,/events/launch-2026/register,302
```
tess_l: Also add internal links from docs/serving-runtime and blog/benchmarks into the launch hub. Prioritize pages with conversion > 0.5%.
sam_r: Short JSON-LD sample for FAQ: 
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Is Redwood private?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, private deployment options available."}}]}
```
pat_k: UTMs: utm_source=webinar_email OR utm_source=organic_social, utm_medium=email|social, utm_campaign=launch_q2. Also add a hidden field in forms: original_cookie_session.
seo-bot: Schedule: run redirect smoke test + canonical crawl 48h after publish.
tess_l: Owners: redirects -> @noah_c, schema & meta -> @sam_r, UTMs -> @pat_k, internal links -> @tess_l. Publish owner -> content-ops.
noah_c: Will open GH PR with the CSV and log steps for rollout. Target Thu morning.
sam_r: I'll write meta tag variations for A/B headline tests and stage them by Wed.
pat_k: I'll post SFDC mapping doc and GTM QA steps by tomorrow.
tess_l: Thanks all. Keep the PR links and ticket numbers in this thread. :memo:
